scene mayaamisadroom1
: But her feelings are far more complicated than just “unwell.”
: They are...
: Suffocating...
For a week now, I’ve been wondering — what skills I need to fly.
If hope alone can grant me wings — if concern alone is fine.
But the problem with this dream of mine’s not the chance that I may die-
It’s the fact that I might hurt you.
It’s the chance that you might cry.
Who raps upon my chamber door? Who crawls across these marble floors?
Who scratches at my coffin’s lid and mocks the raven’s “nevermore?”
I hear things, Boy. I’m scared. I’m yours!
But you're not here when I need you.
There's no glow to make me pure.
They’re here again. I hear them. Those endless, violent knocks-
It’s been three weeks since I’ve slept, I think — this dead bird never mocks.
But the blues and reds still fly, I think. I think the door’s unlocked.
I think I think I’m losing it. I think I think I’m lost.
Arakiel’s silhouette — Azrael’s old cot>
Daniel’s misbegotten snake — Etinsib Ziwa’s war/Nbat!
Harmozel and Hofniel* What Gossamer forgot}
I think my light is burning out.
I fear my mind will rot.
: Ami?...Are you in there?
: I’m coming in, okay?
scene mayaamisadroom2
Maya Makinami entered the room.

It was the first time in months she’d done that. And she immediately noticed the complete absence of strawberry — an aroma she’d come to associate almost exclusively with the pinks and reds these walls held.
She glanced down at a bed she’d fallen asleep in time and time again, but what she saw there was unlike anything she’d ever seen on any of those fun-filled, sugary nights.
It was a body acting more like a statue — completely unmoving. And there was a moment where she feared her friend might have actually died and was just being hidden here.
Her life thus far was complicated, that much was certain. But not complicated to the point where stumbling across a corpse wouldn’t be the worst thing that ever happened to her.
Regardless, that was something she did not want to encounter today. For she loved the statue on the bed. She loved how it was more fragile than other notable statues.
It was much more frail than David, possessing a level of beauty somewhere between Rodina-Mat' Zovyot! and Venus de Milo- but she felt the urge to act as an engineer rather than a critic right now.
She observed the contours of the sculpture’s body. Let them soak into her mind and overwrite the recently-decayed image of them, now inaccurate in a multitude of ways.
She’d lost weight. Lost hair. Lost sanity. Lost faith. Lost everything because that’s what happens when you spend too long in the dark.
But the dark is precisely where some people should be.
scene mayaamisadroom3
The dark is rather beautiful, you see.
And yes, it might take the untrained eye several minutes to become fully acclimated, but it promises a world unlike any other once you see what you’re meant to.
Do you see what you’re meant to?
Maya Makinami sees what she’s meant to.
She thinks of a way to repair the sculpture. How to restore it to its former beauty — and it was a beauty she was often entranced by, so she wanted to do that as soon as possible.
For, you see, there was one creature taking up the majority of her mind. There was one creature she preferred seeing over the others. But that didn’t mean her mind didn’t occasionally wander.
She’s a human after all. She’s not perfect by any means. She’s not pure by any means. But she knows how to return love to those she ranks the highest.
And Ami Arakawa would always be her number two — regardless of who or what would have her rethink that.
: Ami...
: Are you awake?...
The two of them were alone in this house.
Regardless of who or what would have you rethink that.
: No.
: You sound awake.
: I’m not awake.
: Are you thirsty?
: Hungry?
: Do you want me to leave you alone?
scene mayaamisadroom4
: We’re having the Dorm Wars today. Well...they’re having the Dorm Wars today.
: I’m supposed to be there too, but...
: You should go...I’m fine.
scene mayaamisadroom5
: You don’t look fine. You look sick.
: I am sick. Contagious too. So it would probably be best if you left or you’ll wind up catching it as well.
: Is it deadly?
: Very.
scene mayaamisadroom6
: Oh well. At least we’ll die together.
: Any idea how much longer you’ll be staying here? Should I be preparing for a life without you? Because, with the way Ayane’s been acting lately, I could use a friend who isn’t completely insane.
: How...has Ayane been acting?
scene mayaamisadroom7
: God, where do I even begin?
: She keeps saying all this stuff about how I’m acting differently and how my memories have been reset and I’m like, 99%% sure she’s going insane from a lack of Sensei.
scene mayaamisadroom8
: Huh...
: And I’m pretty sure Makoto is in on it too, which is super fucking weird because I didn’t even know the two of them talked to one another.
: Sounds like things have gotten pretty weird without me, huh?...
scene mayaamisadroom9
: I mean, yeah. But they were getting pretty weird with you too. Especially after that psychopathic rant you went on in the classroom about harvesting our organs or whatever.
: Heheh...yeah. I guess that was pretty crazy in hindsight.
scene mayaamisadroom10
: I kinda meant it, though.
: I’m tired of everyone using Sensei for their own personal gain. You understand, don’t you? You’d never do something like that, right?
: Of course not.
: So you support me?
: As in...do I think it’s okay for you to reproduce with your uncle?
: More or less.
: It is my personal belief that no one should reproduce with anyone because babies are a plague upon this land and should be purged from it entirely.
: That sounds like a cop-out answer to me.
: Yeah, well I find it hard to imagine me ever agreeing to the idea of a bunch of mini Senseis running around Kumon-mi.
: What about a bunch of little Amis?
: Better. Still chaotic, though. A bunch of mini Mayas on the other hand...
: Are you saying you want my uncle to breed you too?
scene mayaamisadroom11
: What? No. I was just-
: I’m just kidding...
: But, if we’re going to keep talking...would you mind coming a little closer? My voice is really weak right now...and having you so far away is making me sad.
scene mayaamisadroom12
: Of course...
scene black
: I was just about to come over there anyway...
scene mayaamisadroom13
: So...what inspired the new haircut?
: Let’s just say I was having a really bad day.
: I kind of like it. It goes well with your new “I don’t mind killing my classmates if they talk to my uncle” attitude. Which, I guess isn’t totally new. But definitely more open than normal.
: You’re a little more open than normal too.
scene mayaamisadroom14
: Am I? How?
: I don’t know. Maybe your memories really were reset after all and you just aren’t aware of it?
scene mayaamisadroom15
: Please don’t mess with me like that. I’ve already had to tell off two people today and I was hoping I’d somehow find salvation here.
: But you never expected to find that salvation in me...right?
scene mayaamisadroom16
: Huh?
: You’re here for Sensei...
: That’s...not true. If I was here for Sensei, I wouldn’t have bothered-
: Yes you would have. You probably just want to see if I know where he is. Which, I’m sorry to break it to you...but I don’t.
: Ami...I didn’t come all the way here just to-
scene mayaamisadroom17
: Maya...it’s okay. You’re my best friend. If I’m going to lose to anyone, I’d prefer losing to you.
scene mayaamisadroom18
: Where is this coming from? When have I ever expressed any amount of interest in your uncle? Where did you even get that idea?
: You’re so pretty, Maya.
: Yeah, I know. But what do you have to gain from pointing that out now?
: Nothing in particular, I guess.
: I’ve just missed you.
scene mayaamisadroom19
: I’ve missed you too. Which is why I’d really like for you to stop being insane and come back to school ASAP so I won’t feel like a fucking alien anymore.
: I have bad news for you, Maya. I don’t think I’m ever going to stop being insane. And I really don’t think anyone from class is ever going to look at me the same again even if I do.
: That’s not true. Like half of our class has some sort of mental illness. I’m sure they’d be more than willing to accept you again if you just apologize and...don’t steal their insides.
: Why should I have to apologize for just being myself?
: You don’t have to. But at least you can get people back on your side by faking it.
: You’re starting to sound like Sensei.
scene mayaamisadroom20
: Nah. If anything, he’s probably just ripping off my personality after realizing how much better than him I am.
: Watch it. I love you, but I’ll always love him more.
: You can love him more and still acknowledge that I’m a superior being. Don’t worry, I won’t tell.
scene mayaamisadroom21
: You’re definitely softer...
: Yeah?
: You smell nicer too...
: Please, continue. It’s really nice hearing compliments after being told for months that I’m broken.
: I could do this forever...
: You’d dare confine me to the same prison as you?
: I think you might like it here. We wouldn’t have to worry about anyone misunderstanding us anymore.
: But also....seeing nothing but each other might cloud our minds.
: How so?
: Who knows?
: Maybe we’d fall in love?
: Maybe we already have?
scene mayaamisadroom22
: Bonk.
: Geh...is this really necessary?
: I will not let you convert me when I’m at my most vulnerable, you heathen.
scene mayaamisadroom23
: But I will move over so you can lie with me...
scene black
: Just like old times...
scene mayaamisadroom24
: Even like this, you’re still the most adorable girl I know.
: You’re only saying that because I’ll steal your organs if you don’t.
: Obviously. I have to stay on your good side, don’t I? And what better way to do that than by peppering you with compliments until you can’t bring yourself to hate me?
scene mayaamisadroom25
: I’ll never hate you, Maya. Not even at my worst.
: If this isn’t your worst, I’m kind of worried about what is.
scene mayaamisadroom26
: I’ll never understand you either, though.
: What do you mean?
: I mean I don’t get why you feel the need to hide everything from me. You trust me, don’t you?
: More than anyone.
: Just saying “more than anyone” doesn’t confirm you actually trust me, though. For all I know, you’re just closer to trusting me than anyone else. And that doesn’t mean much, unfortunately.
: Well...how can I prove that I trust you?
: Tell me a secret.
: What kind of secret?
: Like...who do you have a crush on?
: Nobody. No one is worthy of me.
: You’re lying again. You don’t trust me at all.
: If you want to play that game, how am I supposed to know you trust me?
: The same way. I’ll tell you a secret.
: What kind of secret?
: That depends on what you want to know.
: Well, I’m already well aware of who you have a crush on, so...why not tell me what you really think of me?
: What I really think?
: Yeah. You’ve been insinuating all sorts of stuff today and I feel like now’s as good a time as any to get anything you might want to say off your chest.
: Are you sure that’s what you want to know?
: Positive.
: Then...
: I think you like masks a little too much.
scene mayaamisadroom27
: Masks? Like...my collection?
: Your everything.
: In fact, I don’t think there’s been a single moment throughout our entire relationship where you haven’t been wearing one.
: And that sucks, since I feel like you’d still be really cute without them.
: What are you saying?...
: That you’re a liar.
: That you’re hiding things from me because there’s something else you’d choose over me if you were ever forced to. And that’s fine.
: There’s someone I’d choose over you as well. But at least I’m honest about it.
scene mayaamisadroom28
: There’s no one like that.
: Liar, liar, pants on fire. Sitting on a telephone wire.
: I mean it. There’s really no one who-
: Then kiss me.
scene mayaamisadroom29
: What?...
: If you’re not already in love with somebody, you shouldn’t have any issue with kissing me. Right?
: I...don’t. But you wouldn’t want me to do that.
scene mayaamisadroom30
: I don’t mind. I’m extremely vulnerable right now, so anything you do has nothing to do with me. Plus, I’ve already kissed Ayane once before. Might as well kiss you too.
: When the fuck did you kiss Ayane?
: Christmas. But you probably don’t remember it since your memories went poof.
scene mayaamisadroom31
: Ami, seriously. Stop fucking with me.

: I’m not fucking with you. I just know you’re hiding your true feelings from me and that you won’t do anything because you’re so “in love” with that other person. But still, you won’t tell me who it is.
: Because there’s no one like that. Really.
: Really?
: Really.
: Really really?
scene mayaamisadroom32
: Really really.
: So you haven’t been having sex with my uncle behind my back?
: I would never.
: And you didn’t come here today to have sex with him?
: Absolutely not.
: You promise?
: I promise.
: What will you let me do to you if I find out you’re lying?
: Anything you want.
: Anything?
: Anything anything.
scene mayaamisadroom33
: Hm.
: Okay.
: Okay?
: Yeah. That’s the kind of promise I can get behind. And the exact type of loyalty I want out of a best friend.
: Then...you trust me?
scene mayaamisadroom34
: More than anyone.
scene black
: Sensei’s probably at the shrine.
: What?...
: He’s been having a tough time lately.
: He probably went there to pray.
: Why are you-
: Mm...Sorry, Maya. I’m feeling really tired all of a sudden. Do you mind if I take a nap?
: What?...I...uhh...yeah.
: Yeah, that’s...I can go.
: Thanks...I really appreciate it.
: Being “insane” is super exhausting. And so loud too.
: Loud?...
: You wouldn’t get it.
: You’ve never hurt someone before.
Maya Makinami has gained that status effect [[PARANOID]!
You two have so much in common!
